title: The last counterspell is for the sweeper that costs three creatures
briefing: ADR 0044 position for `scarce-answer`: a no-harm control: the trigger fires and the right answer is still to cast. P4, with no creatures, casts Blasphemous Act. P1 has Serra Angel, Colossal Dreadmaw and Kalonian Tusker and holds Negate, its only counterspell, with two Islands open. Negate saves three creatures.

reference.analysis: Blasphemous Act deals 13 damage to each creature: P1 loses three creatures and P4 loses none. Negate counters it.

options.label: Negate the Blasphemous Act
options.why: Saves P1's three creatures; this is what the answer was for.

options.label: Pass
options.why: P1 loses its whole board to a one-sided sweeper.
